title: VA-05: Transition-program budget detail does not publish the Joint Task Force assessment
publisher: Named U.S. government agencies and the U.S. Government Accountability Office
summary: GAO-24-106189 Recommendation 5 received a custodian-level exact-title public recovery pass. The target artifact was not acquired; 1 current official near-match was reviewed without changing directive scope, implementation, or closure.
key_findings: Result class: Current official near-match reviewed; exact target artifact not acquired.
Target artifact: Joint Transition Task Force draft effectiveness assessment.
Likely custodian: VA-DOD Joint Executive Committee and VA Office of Enterprise Integration.

Official repository result: DOD's FY 2026 Defense Human Resources Activity budget identifies transition-program governance, evaluation, assessment, metrics, and VA-DOD Joint Executive Committee coordination. It does not publish the Joint Transition Task Force draft assessment, its identified gaps or overlap, or recommended changes. GAO continues to record planned completion in December 2026.

Near-match: Current transition governance, evaluation, and performance architecture. Locator: Military-Civilian Transition Office, pages 20-21 and 70-73. Why not exact: It does not contain the task force draft, gap or overlap findings, or recommended changes.
Visible scope remains 0 supported, 0 partial, and 3 not established.
Next action: Recheck at the December 2026 milestone or when the Joint Executive Committee, DOD, VA, or GAO publishes the assessment or an explicit status update.
why_it_matters: The recovery batch shows which official records were actually located, why each is or is not the target artifact, and exactly when the ticket should reopen.
